relevance_note: Retrospective cohort with per-patient table of NOD2 genotypes and features: 'Clinical data of 47 Chinese children who were diagnosed with Blau syndrome'.
method_note: Table 1 (one row per patient, 47 rows) was transcribed by a Python script in the scratch directory, splitting each cell on ';'; output checked against the table by hand. Patients are labelled 'Table 1 #<n>' from the bare-number 'Patient no' column. All 47 patients carry a diagnosis of Blau syndrome and are in scope, including the 19 with no NOD2 variant listed (text: variants 'identified in 28 patients'); those 19 have no variant rows. Affected relatives named in the 'Family history' column (father of #4; mother and grandmother of #12; grandmother, aunt and father of #18; mother of #22, #30, #31) get individual rows with no features or variants (not tested, no detail beyond 'affected'). #14 and #15 ('affected twins older sister' / 'affected twins younger sister') are taken to be each other's twin (8 familial cases from 7 families per the Results), so no extra twin rows were created. Age at onset values are in months per the column header (quoted as second span). Age at presentation (= onset + 'Delay in diagonosis') was not recorded as age at diagnosis because the table does not label it as such; age at last evaluation not given per patient (only duration of follow-up). Empty cells are 'not reported'. The Uveitis column contains 'papules' for #38, #42, #43, #45 and #47 (apparently misplaced rash entries); these were not recorded as ocular features. Checklist: 'Renal involvement', 'Cardiac involvement', 'Nerve deafness' and 'Central nervous system involvememt' were not mapped to nephritis/renal failure, pericarditis or neuropathy (not specific). 'Bilateral blurred vision' mapped to visual impairment; 'Artertis' to vasculitis; any Rash-column entry (incl. 'pigmentary macula') to skin rash. 'No patients were blind at baseline' gave an excluded 'blind' feature row for every patient (group statement); it does not exclude the broader checklist item. Inflammatory markers are reported only as group means (Tables 2-3), so the checklist item is 'not reported'; 'Routine blood tests ... were normal' was not used per person. Treatment is per person only for NSAIDs ('all patients used NSAIDs'); other treatments are group counts. Variant type 'missense' recorded only for R334Q/R334W from the Discussion sentence naming those variants as missense; functional evidence for R334W and R587C is from a cited study (Matsuda et al.) quoted in the Discussion. Pathogenicity is the per-row 'Classfication'. Zygosity and inheritance are not stated. Contradictions/inconsistencies: text says arthritis in 44 patients (93.4%; abstract 93.6%) and 34 polyarthritis, but Table 1 lists articular involvement for 45 patients, 35 with polyarthritis; abstract says 20 patients (42.6%) received TNF inhibitors but Results say 34 (72.3%); Discussion says '27.66% of patients presented with BS associated arthritis' where vasculitis is meant. Reference [5] (Li C et al. 2017, Chinese children with Blau syndrome) shares authors but the paper does not state patient overlap, so cites_prior_report is null.
